field_notes.schema_version: Stable schema contract for scale-lab workload catalog and proof artifacts.
field_notes.catalog_id: Stable identifier for this workload catalog fixture.
field_notes.evidence_mode: Declares whether evidence is simulated, replayed locally, rch-offloaded, or from a live mux run.
field_notes.target_pane_count: Total pane-equivalent count; must equal the sum of workload_mix pane_count values.
field_notes.host: Host shape captured with enough detail to prevent unsupported hardware claims.
field_notes.command: Reproduction command, target dir, and feature flags used for this proof lane.
field_notes.workload_mix: Persona-weighted workload taxonomy for idle, active, noisy, rate-limited, TUI-heavy, search-heavy, workflow-heavy, and distributed panes.
field_notes.timings: Elapsed time and API latency percentiles from the proof run.
field_notes.memory: Peak RSS plus hot/warm/cold memory envelope evidence.
field_notes.disk: Bytes written and post-run free-space evidence.
field_notes.events: Detection, workflow, dropped-event, and capture-gap counters.
field_notes.limitations: Truth labels that say what this artifact does not prove.
field_notes.artifacts: Machine-readable logs and traces emitted by the proof lane.

command.command_line: rch exec -- env CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/tmp/ft-s6h49-silverharbor-target cargo test -p frankenterm-core scale_lab_workload_catalog --lib --no-default-features

limitations: rch replay smoke artifact; not a live mux or 64-core/256GB proof
pane count is 10 pane-equivalents and cannot graduate larger support claims
